title: eBay to buy GSI Commerce for $2.4 billion
summary: eBay announced its acquisition of GSI Commerce for approximately $2.4 billion, a move aimed at strengthening its e-commerce offerings. This acquisition is intended to help eBay become a major player in the big-brand e-commerce market, moving beyond its traditional auction hub image. GSI Commerce provides e-commerce technology, fulfillment, customer care, and marketing services to numerous physical brands.

title: Tech Watch: Amazon Introduces A New Music Locker, Beating Apple And Google
summary: Amazon.com Inc. has launched a new digital music locker service called Amazon Cloud Drive and Amazon Cloud Player, allowing users to store and access music, photos, and videos online. This move positions Amazon ahead of competitors Apple and Google, who are also expected to release similar services. The service offers 5 GB of free storage and aims to drive more digital music sales for Amazon.

title: Why cloud storage is the future of music
summary: Amazon's new Cloud Drive service for music is highlighted as a significant step towards the future of online music storage, known as "cloud music." The article explains the benefits of convenience and accessibility that cloud music offers over traditional local storage, while also addressing challenges like internet connectivity issues and legal disputes with the music industry regarding licensing. It details Amazon's service, mentions alternatives, and briefly touches on rumors about Google and Apple entering the market.
